page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.5 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes bundled hardware accelerators and local storage. Specifically, it features 2 NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the instance is provisioned with a 944 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

The CPU configuration lacks hyper-threading, as indicated by the single thread per core specification, and does not expose advanced vector extensions or hardware-accelerated cryptography flags in this configuration. This makes the instance highly dependent on its dual NVIDIA P100 GPUs for parallel processing tasks. The qualitative cost profile reflects a specialized GPU-accelerated hardware class with dedicated resources and local SSD storage. It is designed for workloads such as GPU-accelerated database operations, machine learning inference, and parallel scientific computing.
